Name: Confluence Forest Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
This Farm map replaces the base Forest Farm Map. (So it has forage and the Stumps respawn)
It also contains a small additional map, that also has the Forest Farm Forage spawns on it.
I also added a quarry area like is present in the hilltop farm.

Basics for installing a mod, Download, put it in your mods folder in your stardew valley folder, (which smapi should generate when it is installed) along with all the required mods, then just play the game and select the forest farm.

It should be compatible with all other mods, even recolors. (though if it changes the waterfall color, that wont change.)

If you encounter any problems please let me know as soon as possible so i can get to work fixing them.

Recommended Companion Mods
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]
Allows you to break bushes to free up space if you want it.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6460]Waterproof Items
[/url]Makes it so Items Float instead of being lost in water.﻿

Cool Mods I like to recommend.

[/url]﻿To have extra little houses and upgrade them :)
